concrete_gaps: Current private WC-v2 package omits four encoder libraries and encoder OMX component configuration; static inputs exist but have not been integrated.
v27 has no dedicated cedar_dev_ve2 encoder node/driver, ENC clocks/reset/PPU/bypass-master3 path, encoder IRQ or WAIT_EN/VCU_EN implementation. Decoder1080p acceptance does not cover these.

Current t736-ve heap accepts only its actual decoder device and current MemAdapter uses a global context with decoder-default open. Encoder allocation/import ownership must be designed explicitly; no foreign heap or first-SG identity shortcut.
Current128MiB permanent import quarantine and decoder-only buffer policy are bring-up constraints, not a production encode/decode memory lifecycle.

First encoder validation still needs a known raw-frame input, actual encoder IRQ/completion, valid output bitstream, software decode comparison, error handling and teardown checks. No encoder quality, performance or supported-format claim is validated.
